premises.text: Friends' social influence drives product discovery better than solitary need-based search
premises.evidence_span: friends do help friends discover products

premises.text: Showing real people looking at real products signals popularity like a mall
premises.evidence_span: the first thing you will see is real people looking at real products. This visual proof of people looking at products, just like the hustle and bustle of a mall, gives us a sense of popularity of the products

premises.text: Aspirational brands are curated into a daily personalized store from user and friend likes
premises.evidence_span: Sneak Peek works with aspirational brands in apparel, accessories, premium foods, and hospitality space. to curate a selection for you. We use what you and your friends like on Sneak Peek to create a store every single day just for you

premises.text: Each product view shows which friends have already peeked
premises.evidence_span: Every single time you see a product on Sneak Peek, you also get to see which of your friends have peeked or looked at that product before

premises.text: Limited daily peeks intelligently drop price until someone buys, creating urgency
premises.evidence_span: every peek drops the price for everyone peeking. It drops it intelligently until someone buys. A user gets a limited number of peeks in a day

premises.text: In-product social proof and friend advice move users from discovery to one-click purchase
premises.evidence_span: This adds the social proof we all need to move us from discovery to purchase

premises.text: Works on web, inside Facebook, and on tablets
premises.evidence_span: Sneak Peek works on sneakpeek.com. It works inside the comforts of Facebook, so you never have to leave Facebook to use Sneak Peek. It also works on a tablet of your choice

premises.text: Long-term brand partnerships deliver impulse sales and social engagement
premises.evidence_span: For our brands, we form long-term partnerships, and we help them deliver meaningful sales, which are mostly impulse, and we help them deliver meaningful engagement on social channels

value.text: Social commerce that moves people from friend-driven discovery to purchase
value.evidence_span: move us from discovery to purchase

secondary_value.text: Meaningful impulse sales and social engagement for partner brands
secondary_value.evidence_span: help them deliver meaningful sales, which are mostly impulse, and we help them deliver meaningful engagement on social channels

causal_links.evidence_span: When I find a friend that I trust, then I'm more likely to buy a product
game mechanics, such as competition and urgency, really drive sales

notes: Soft count at 8. Pilot peek counts and $10 credit excluded as traction/promo. Brand value coded secondary.
